action.objective: Develop and secure the center with Ne4, then continue developing/castling while managing Black's d4 pawn.
action.rationale: Ne4 is the only commit-ready move (exact 25 at depth 3, deepest evidence). Safety probe complete: no immediate mate, no tactical refutation. Black's d4 pawn cannot be profitably taken (Nxd4 cxd4), and Ne4 keeps the knight active hitting c5/f6/g5 without hanging material; if Bxe4 dxe4 opens lines. Tentative line: ...g5 Ng3 retreating.
